description: This Java class 'PcbMergeTool' handles merging and processing of PCB design files, including copying, optimizing, and merging PCB components, nets, zones, and modules based on change requests.

classes.name: PcbMergeTool
classes.description: Main class for merging PCB files, handling change requests, and updating PCB components and nets.

classes.name: Networks
classes.description: Inner class managing PCB network name to ID mappings, including registration and lookup functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for processing PCB merge operations based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: findModuleByName
methods.description: Finds a module in the PCB node tree by its name.

methods.name: mergePcb
methods.description: Merges source PCB data into destination PCB node, updating nets, zones, arcs, lines, labels, modules, segments, and vias.

methods.name: removeNodes
methods.description: Removes modules from PCB node tree based on specific criteria.

methods.name: shouldRemove
methods.description: Determines if a module should be removed based on its reference name and delete requests.

methods.name: fixNetId
methods.description: Updates net IDs and names in PCB nodes, handling net merging requests.
